title: Your AI CFO. Without the CFO price tag.: Your AI CFO. Without the CFO price tag. | Product Hunt
excerpt: Fintoit is an AI CFO for early-stage startups. Get real-time burn rate, runway, and cash flow visibility, an AI assistant that answers financial questions instantly, and investor-ready reports generated in under 30 seconds. Free to start, no credit card required. Built for founders who need financial clarity without the cost of hiring a CFO.
